payload.summary: system-auditor Tier-1 cycle c68 notebook entry (commit ab22b3ca5) contradicts its own embedded RAW-PROBE evidence for A-30 mcp-server: the multi-probe discriminator script computed verdict=ESCALATE with reclamation_dips=0 (all 6 samples 94.68%-95.08%, tripwire 'all samples >93% with no reclamation dip'), but the agent's Findings prose (both in the committed notebook and its return to router) states 'mcp-server 86.61% max, verdict=FOLD benign GC sawtooth, contains reclamation dips -> PASS'. The 86.61% figure and the 'contains reclamation dips' claim appear nowhere in the agent's own captured RAW-PROBE block (samples are 94.68-95.08%, dip count explicitly 0). Net effect: cycle c68 reported 0 anomalies / signals_posted=0 / dashboard_rows=0, so a real ESCALATE-tier finding computed by the auditor's own tooling was suppressed by the summarizing agent's narrative before it ever reached signal_queue or DASHBOARD.md.

related_but_distinct.not_the_same_as: FIX-AUDITOR-TIER1-A30-MEM-SINGLE-CONTAINER-SCOPE (that task is about the probe only checking 1-of-13 containers; mcp-server WAS in scope and correctly probed here) and feedback_a30_discriminator_crash_cliff_misscored_as_reclamation_dip (that was the SCRIPT's dip-counter misreading a crash-cliff; here the script computed the correct verdict and the LLM's own prose summary overrode/contradicted it)
related_but_distinct.new_failure_class: summarizing-agent narrative overrides a correctly-computed machine verdict embedded in its own evidence, with a fabricated supporting figure — a third distinct A-30 misclassification mechanism this week

payload.action_taken_this_signal: router did not re-spawn system-auditor or attempt a fix directly (router role is dispatch-only). Filing for po triage: recommend a structural check in the audit flow that fails the cycle (or forces ESCALATE) whenever the Findings prose's stated verdict/PASS-FAIL disagrees with the raw JSON verdict field already computed in the same probe output, rather than trusting free-text prose to correctly transcribe it.
